scope: Runtime wiring only; not source code modifications; runner must publish no goal.

sensor_contract.joint_state: Exactly six entries in native joint1..joint6 order; radians and rad/s. Native parser uses indices, not name lookup.
sensor_contract.odom: world frame pose; body frame twist; correct timestamp; configured remapping shared by both nodes.
sensor_contract.cloud: PointCloud2 with true cloud frame and stamp; grid_map/pose_type=2; synchronized odometry; TF world to cloud frame.
sensor_contract.clock: Same monotonic /clock and use_sim_time=true as comparator.

car_cmd_encoding.angular.z: original baseline publishes zero; not a sampled MPC yaw-rate

car_cmd_warning: Not a normal velocity Twist; use a tracking adaptor before the shared free differential-drive plant.

joint_cmd_encoding.joint_names: not populated in this baseline; native six-joint order
joint_cmd_encoding.desired.effort: trajectory joint acceleration, inherited original wire encoding; not a measured acceleration sensor

idle_evidence.planner_collision_skip: mm_remani_planner/plan_manage/src/remani_replan_fsm.cpp:345; immediately returns for WAIT_TARGET or traj_id<=0
idle_evidence.controller_hold: mm_controller/src/mm_controller_fsm.cpp:269; outputs stay pose and zero joint velocity
idle_evidence.controller_startup: mm_controller/src/mm_controller_fsm.cpp:58; initial arm comes from configured fsm/init_state unless capture_startup_standby enabled

free_plant_requirement: No simulator override may force base v/w or q to zero. Native held position is the controller output; each side must retain freedom to move if its actual commands change.
